▪ Special Stage selector: Sets starting Chaos Emerald count.

▪ Bounce from objects while holding button (matches MD).
▪ Springs: Sonic adopts ball attack when falling or when holding down.
▪ Sonic can kill badniks when starting spindash.

▪ By collecting all 7 Chaos Emeralds you can use Super Sonic.
▪ Point counting can be skipped.

181031.overview:
A port from the Atari 5200 to the NES.
 
Scramble is a side scrolling shooter. Piloting a plane through varied (and mountainous) terrain, your goal is to infiltrate an enemy base and destroy it. Missiles, tanks, UFO's, and other enemy artillery can all be found and will try to stop you. Colliding with any of these enemies, enemy fire, or the landscape will cause you to lose one of your planes. To fight back, your plane is equipped with both bombs and guns which can destroy most of the enemies you'll encounter. Your plane has a limited amount of fuel, and you'll crash if you run out. To replenish the fuel supply, you must bomb the fuel depots which will appear on the ground occasionally.

181034.overview:
When Okarin and his friends made the "PhoneWave (name subject to change)," they had no idea it would have the ability to send emails to the past and, as a result, change the present.

Tragedy strikes as an organization behind a global conspiracy seeks to obtain their invention and threaten the fate of humanity!

But even when the outcome changes, their fate ends in disaster time and time again...

Face with overwhelming despair, which future will Okarin choose?

Change the past to save the future!

181632.overview:
Super Mario 14 is a hack of the Japan-exclusive Famicom title Kaiketsu Yanchamaru 3: Taiketsu! Zouringen, the second follow-up to Kid Niki: Radical Ninja. Its title screen suggests it was published in 1993. Super Mario 14 has a nearly identical PCB to Super Bros. 11.

It is a side-scrolling platformer game much like other Mario games on NES.

181817.overview:
Felix the Cat (AKA The Cat Felix 3) is an unlicensed and pirate platform game developed and published by Dragon Co. in 1998. It is unrelated to Hudson Soft's official Felix the Cat title, released in 1992, but the gameplay of the two games is very similar.
The plot of the story is based off an old Felix cartoon called "The Goose That Laid the Golden Egg", where a pirate dog called "Captain Kidd" captures Felix' golden goose, Goldie (Felie Goose in this game), which lays gold eggs that can be transformed into real gold Felix gives to the poor.

This game was later hacked into The Hacker, released standalone by Nanjing and on some plug-&-play Famiclone systems, and then into "Super Hero", found exclusively on plug-&-play systems, such as DreamGEAR's 75-in-1 controller.

182118.overview: Super Mario goes on a solo commando mission against the Koopa empire to find out what happened to his brother, Luigi. Along his quest, Mario faces various Koopa Troopa threats including Koopas, floating Lakitus, Bullet Bill, the Hammer brothers, Bloober and a final battle against King Koopa.

182417.overview: This hack fixes the problems with the scroll when you walk, simplifies the controls, change the sprite of Turrican, and a few other little improvements to make the game more enjoyable.

182961.overview: A modded version of Super Mario Bros on NES with sprites from Legend of Zelda and Zelda 2.

183222.overview:
A frenetic 4-player space-themed party game for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Race through space and blast your friends in Spacey McRacey, a chaotic 4-player party game for use with your NES 4-score. Your goal is to be the first person to pass each barrier. Dodge the barriers, blast your friends, grab powerups, and try to be the person at the top!

Spacey McRacey was my submission the 2016 NESDev Competition.

183227.overview:
Super Uwol is a 2D platformer created for the devkitSMS competition 2016 and it largely retains the concept of the original 2009 Uwol: Quest for Money by the same developers. 

Each room represents a single-screen platform level with coins and enemies. By moving through sides of the screen horizontally the character appears on the other side. When all coins are collected two exits appears and Uwol can choose a new level in the pyramid with some freedom for the path to follow based on the chosen exit.

183468.overview: A Gothic, Halloween themed version of Arkanoid.

183707.overview:
The game is a simplified version of the original Street Fighter II. The player can choose from 4 characters: Ryu, Chun-Li, Guile and Zangief. There is also Vega (M. Bison in Western territories) as the final boss, although his name is misspelled as "Viga" in this game. They all have their moves (although Zangief's Spinning Piledriver seems to be missing). Like in the original version, the player fights through the other selectable characters (here in a preset order), eventually reaching the final battle with M.Bison/Vega. The player only gets one continue, unlike the official game.

There is no difficulty selection and the game itself has hard AI (but the AI isn't as poorly programmed as the fighting games under Cony Soft's name), and it also has English in some areas, especially in the ending cutscenes.

185797.overview:
Super Royal Pals. 2 is a ROM hack of Super Mario Bros. 2. The game replaces the 4 main characters with whole new sprites of Princess Peach, Princess Daisy, Mayor Pauline and Princess Roselina. 

The game does not contain any new levels, however each of the characters have new abilities that they did not have before. 

The lives system has been replaced with a "Death Counter" instead, and 1-UP Mushrooms remove a death from the counter. The slot game has been replaced with collecting 3 coins removes a death from the death counter.

185943.overview:
The evil King Bowser has stolen your people, your treasure and your plumber. Do you have what it takes to fight though eight action-packed worlds to get them back?

Play as the amazing Princess Peach or Daisy in this life-free platformer.

186924.overview: Sir Ababol: Remastered Edition is an updated release of the 2013 NES homebrew title Sir Ababol. This release improves the original game by correcting a number of map bugs and imperfections. It also adds new colours and tweaks the movement to optimize it and make it more responsive. By completing the game two additional playable characters can be unlocked. Completing it once unlocks Zazelle and a second time Johnny Limite. They each have different moves providing different gameplay.

189894.overview:
Super Smash Bros. NES's gameplay is very similar to that of the official Super Smash Bros games. In this one, Mario, Kirby, Samus, Link, Mega Man and Ninja Gaiden's Ryu duke it out. 

Unlike other fighting games, damage is measured by percentage and fighting focuses more on hitting enemies off the stage. The higher the percentage, the easier it is to knock enemies off the stage.

190647.overview:
Super Royal Pals. 3 is a "What If" hack. What if Nintendo decided to make the ladies of the Mushroom Kingdom the stars of the story. Takes place on the 8 Worlds outside of the Mushroom Kingdom. 

The hack removes lives and score and replaces it with a death counter. It also improves movement with suits and makes the Fireball suit better. You can now hold up when shooting a fireball to shoot upward.

You will also get a random power up at the end of 3 end-goal stages.

190899.overview:
Okay, so... Long story short, it's SMB1 with SMB3 elements, like World Maps (Hammer Bros. included), Super Leaf & Frog Suit. It has a 2P CO-OP feature as well, like the NSMB series. It also has a few more features, but those are only available with a secret code that you get when you beat the game.

And graphically speaking, I'm speechless. This looks AWESOME! Colorful backgrounds, 16-bit like sprites, and a bit more... Sound department is the same, but with SMB3 tunes added in for good measure. You can't complain, and I sure didn't.

So... Yeah, I'm pretty sure you want to get this and play it so bad. And this time around, it should be easy to pick up and play. You just need to follow this instruction carefully and you are good to go.

192582.overview: The Supervision 110-in-1 is a multicart containing 93 games made by Supervision in the early 90's.

192943.overview:
Silicon Statue erects a musical homage to days long gone, with an intense crispness that immerses the listener in a world of magic and mystery. The fifth album by Zi is incredibly diverse in tone and timbre, keeping the listener’s ears alert and their heart’s happy.

This album was made with the Famitracker and uses only the original NES chipset.

195593.overview:
A very bizarre hack of the classic The Legend of Zelda, with Kyle from South Park as the main character and the occasional character that we will find.

The map is totally changed (except the dungeons); in addition, the textures have been simplified in reference to the animation series.

Kyle does not look much like him in the video because he was already wearing the red hat (red ring in the original) and the colors of the cute character become red.

The final scene, which by the way was difficult for me to get to (since some dungeons are in crazy places) and in which Ganon is replaced by what seems to be Kyle's mother (or the Cartman, who knows).

197205.overview:
Super Mario Unlimited Deluxe is a traditional-style Mario hack with difficulty ramping up from beginner to expert. It is based on the Super Mario Bros engine, but has been completely reworked into a whole new adventure.

Changes from the original game include:

-41 Original Levels!
-Unlimited Lives!
-New Power-up! The stopwatch lets Mario freeze his enemies
-New Mechanics! Mario can super jump off enemies by holding A
-New Collectable! Find all 32 Mario coins to unlock secrets
-New Graphics and Music! A familiar mix of new and old

200494.overview:
Limited to 101 copies, the Numbered Addition (NA) Edition of Swords and Runes III includes the following:

-Numbered title screen, 000-100
-Translucent gold/yellow cartridge
-Brand new GTROM board by Membler Industries
-Box, manual, and label
-Plastic cart sleeve
-Styrofoam block

200495.overview:
Super Gun is a shooter and one of the rarest games for the Nintendo Entertainment System. There were unlicensed Famicom and NES versions, neither had ever been dumped.  In North America, it was also part of the unreleased and unlicensed sequel to Caltron 6-in-1, Caltron 9-in-1.  

It was extracted from the only known Caltron 9-in-1 prototype in 2019 by Frank Cifaldi.  The only known difference between this version and the 72-pin version is the copyright date on the title screen.

200496.overview:
Super Tilt Bro is a demake of the Super Smash Bros. series compatible with the good old Nintendo Entertainment System from the 1980s.

You and a friend take control of a clone of Sinbad, the badass mascot of Ogre3D. Two fellows, one platform: you will have to fight to throw the other out.

200499.overview: Inspired by the best kinds of bar games (ones with simple rules that become more enjoyable the longer you play), by goofing around, and by my generation’s childlike enthusiasm for that piece of gray plastic, Super Russian Roulette (SRR) is a brand new party game for the NES. One unhinged 8-bit cowboy is prepared to call you yellow, call you crazy, mourn your death, or kick up his boots for the last time. One bullet waits in the light gun’s chamber. You, up to two friends, and The Cowboy take turns passing the pistol, spinning the chamber (or not!), and drinking to your own demise (or not).

200500.overview:
In this classic snake game, eat numbers to make your snake longer! Battle through 25 obstacle filled levels with precise movements to survive. Three difficulty levels keep the challenges coming faster each time. Once you have mastered the movement, play with a friend in vs or cooperative mode, or play against the computer. Can you slither your way to greatness?

This homebrew first appeared as an entry by Matrixz in the 2004 Minigame Competition. That original NeSnake is also included on the cart! Updated graphics, more levels, and extra game play modes make this one of the best homebrews yet. When you are done playing, a simple 4 character password lets you keep your levels unlocked for continuation later.

200502.overview: Super Donkey Kong (スーパードンキーコング), also titled as Jungle King (叢林金剛) in Chinese, is a bootleg port of Donkey Kong Land (called Super Donkey Kong GB in Japan) developed by Ei-How Yang and published by Hosenkan Electronics in 1997.

201396.overview: While Mario is romping through the Mushroom Kingdom’s royal water fountains one day, he is witness to a mysterious phenomenon: the fish from around the kingdom begin to take flight! It’s up to the Mario Brothers to find out what is responsible (I wonder…) and stop it before the local fish markets are all dried up! Note that this is a “mini-hack” – a novelty/concept hack that is complete and spawns only one world.

201418.overview: The most offensive ROM Hack you've ever seen! Compleatly changes Mario Bros. graphics into nazi, racist, pornographic imagery.

202166.overview:
Spacegulls is a short platformer for the NES.  It is best described as a combination of Joust and Mega Man.  1-2 players

The first version of Spacegulls was made in 1 week and won 1st place in the NESdev Compo 2020/21. 

Trouble in the neighborhood! Dr. Beak from OVO (The Odious Villains  Organization) is researching the secret of eternal life, digging everywhere with the  help of his cyborg bird army to collect legendary fossil eggs. Time to spread your wings, put an end to his evil plans and save your chicks!

203052.overview:
This Hack is a request from Super Buni. Enjoy it! The main concept? To remake Super Bros. 8, a Chinese bootleg that used the excellent Don Doko Don 2 (1992, Taito) as a base.

Because the changes made by the Chinese in the game are poorly implemented, it has been chosen to redo all the work from scratch. Here are some of the changes:

● New Intro and title screen

● New text font ripped from Super Mario Bros. 3.

● Using as a base the excellent English translation of Don Doko Don 2 by MrRichard999 and Guyver, the cinematics are partially redrawn and the script is adapted to go along with the Hack theme.

● Main sprite and 90% of the enemies have been replaced or modified

● Minor changes to the backgrounds

● By popular demand and thinking that most people who are nostalgic for this cartridge are Spanish-speaking, it also includes a Spanish translation.

● Some funny cameos and Easter Eggs have been added.

And much more! Just take a look at the Readme file, or play the game and enjoy it!

205742.overview:
Street Fighter II was one of the games that really stoked the fires of the 16-bit console war, with the SNES version selling millions and making Genesis / Mega Drive owners green with envy – until, of course, they got their own version of Capcom's famous one-on-one brawler.

Street Fighter II was duly ported to pretty much every platform of the period – including the Game Boy – but one machine that didn't get the game was the NES. Sure, there was an unlicensed Famicom port by Hummer Team in 1992, but it was so terrible most people have scrubbed it from their memory banks.

However, it seems that the NES is finally getting the Street Fighter II port it deserves, thanks to a group of passionate coders. As reported by Eventhubs, Street Fighter 2 Deluxe is a fan-made effort that is shaping up quite nicely indeed – as you can see from the footage below, it runs smoothly, despite the tiny sprites.

206997.overview:
This is a short hack of Super Mario Bros. with Touhou Project themed graphics.

The player character is based on Touhou character, Letty Whiterock.

207133.overview:
Titanic (also known as Titanic 2005) is an unlicensed Famicom game made by Nice Code/Dragon Co. and published by Shenzhen Nanjing Technology in 2005.

It can also be found on certain plug & play systems, under a different name.
Overview

In Titanic, you can choose to play as Jack or Rose, and your objective is to escape the ship. The game uses the same (or similar) gameplay engine as Dragon Co.'s other platformers, although the game does control somewhat differently. You can climb up ledges by pressing up like in Prince of Persia, and the B button now just makes you run faster instead of using a weapon.

208062.overview: Spirit Impel began life as a Byte-Off 2020 game jam submission by Passe Gaming. It was later developed into a full fledged game, completed several months later. It features plenty of "tongue in check" humor as you take on the role of Vin Katana, who must defeat the intergalactic corporation Ultra before they turn every video game in the universe into a pachinko machine. It appears the villains of the game are a parody of Konami. In gameplay terms the game is fairly straight forward, you make your way through six stages avoiding obstacles, shooting enemies and each stage ends with a boss fight.

210483.overview:
Once upon a time... or maybe twice... there wa an unearthly paradise called Pepperland. 80000 leagues beneath the sea, it lay- or lie- I'm not too sure.

The protectors of Pepperland, Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band have been captured by THE BLUE MEANIES. Their plan is to ban music and steal all colour.

Admiral Fred in his Yellow Submarine recruited THE BEATLES to be the new protectors, bring back the music and the colours.

Only they can save Pepperland!

210611.overview: This version of Sudoku was made specifically for distribution on the NES site, NESWorld, by Al Bailey. Releasing in 2007, Sudoku was the first major release for the Nintendo Entertainment system in more than 10 years and is considered the first widely released homebrew NES game.

210954.overview:
Utaco was originally an entry for A Game By Its Cover (http://www.agbic.com/).

The contest idea was to choose a fake cartridge art (with an special focus on Famicompo entries) and then develop that game in a month.
One of those entries, was うたいたガールUTACO~「ＩＩコンは世界を救う？！」 by ふじのきともこ

The main idea of a game played with the almost never used Famicom microphone seemed fun enough for me to try to do, so that is how I choose it.

The game was not finished when the competition ended, but with some work on the following months, it reached its actual status.

The game features music by Surasshu, so go and give thanks to him later when you can't get the tunes out of your head.

210956.overview: 50 years ago, the evil magician known as Malice appeared and within days blighted the land and corrupted it's people. Seeking greater power, he discovered the half-genie known as Shera who's power was pure and sent his 40 Thieves to steal her away so to absorb her power. Shera's son, Sarzha, is the only one left who is unaffected by Malice's blight. Armed with only a ring that staves off death, Sarzha marches into Malice's stronghold alone to save his mother - but time is not on his side. Malice's ritual to absorb Shera is nearly complete, and unless Sarzha can reach her in time she will be lost - and Malice will rule the land, forever.

210988.overview:
8-bit platformer for the NES that makes everyone a speedrunner. Playable on real hardware or modern devices.

The whole game is designed around a unique checkpoint mechanic that will only award a checkpoint when the player proves their mastery of a screen.

At the start you have two difficulty options to choose from. They affect the timer, which might seem insignificant, but as you play you will notice makes a big difference.

For those who truly master the game, the mechanical nightmare challenge levels await...

212798.overview:
Super Mario Club refers to Famicom Network System software (known as a "communication cartridge") introduced in 1990 only for store staff, and its associated game sales research by Nintendo.

Super Mario Club is not technically a game, however Mario cameos in the interface for the software, and the box art features the same artwork as Mario Club Co., Ltd.

The original 1990 release came with a blue Mario logo/text. Later, a 1991 version was released with the same logo/text but in red.

Super Mario Club would have been set up for Japanese toy shops, in which consumers would be able to receive the latest reviews for Famicom games. The database would be shared between every toy shop which had the software. It was possible for consumers to submit their own feedback, and their data (such as search history) would be tracked by Nintendo.

214061.overview:
Super Mario Bros. 2: Christmas Edition is a special edition of the original Super Mario Bros. 2 game with updated graphics. All 20 stages remain the same, but the graphics have been changed to fit within the holidays.

Changes from the original game:

Mario, Luigi, Toad, and Peach have new outfits to match the theme for the holidays.
Birdo has been replaced by Frosty the Snowman. Frosty shoots snowballs instead of eggs.
On all stages, snow falls in the background.
POW Blocks have POW replaced by HO!.
Shy Guys wear Santa hats.
Waterfalls are frozen.
Mushroom Blocks have been replaced by presents, Santa hats, tree ornaments, and ball ornaments.
The final boss, Wart wears a Santa hat. Wart spits out big snowballs instead of bubbles.

216314.overview:
Can you become a World Champion or will you BREAK?

Sara Parker's Pool Challenge gives you 4 fast-breaking styles of pool to choose from Standard, 8-ball, 9-ball, and Kelly Pool - each with realistic sound and music.

Challenge up to 4 friends or play alone, this is as close to being in a actual Pool Hall. To keep things interesting and fresh, change up the table top surface to make the balls go wild!

Grab your Cuestick and get ready for the hottest billiards action around.

Rack'em Up...

216746.overview:
The sewers of The Mushroom Kingdom have been infested by teenage mutant ninja turtles, It's up to Mario and Luigi to save the day by becoming Teenage Super Ninja Plumbers!

The first version of this hack was made in one week for the SMB JAM on SMB ARENAÂ´s discord. The theme was "turtles" and most of the jam time went to make the TMNT/SMB music mashups. The gamejam version does have bugs and is to be considered a demo version!

A final version was made in one month. Both the jam version and the finalized version are included as an example for what can be done in a week compared to a month.

216911.overview:
Spooky Soccer is a 1-4 player sports simulation NES game. You play as a friendly ghost helping your team win. As a ghost you have 4 special abilities you can perform all of which have a cooldown upon being used:

    Musicbox - Puts nearby players to sleep.
    Scare - Scares the ball handler (if nearby) causing them to shoot.
    Promote - Increases the natural abilities of a player on the field.
    TNT - Causes an explosion on the field hurling nearby players to the ground.

217894.overview: Super Mario Adventures is a ROM hack of Tiny Toon Adventures. It changes many of the sprites to Mario universe sprites making the game like a Mario game. This was done as the game was felt to be highly inspired by the Mario series in it’s gameplay and design. All four characters have been changed to Mario in different forms of Transformations. The story has also been altered to use President/King Koopa from the SMB movie instead of Montana Max. Other characters have also been changed to characters found in the Mario universe such as Peach and Toad.

217948.overview: Super Crusher Fighters is an NES game about rescuing people while outrunning and outmaneuvering an encroaching spiked wall.

218002.overview:
Super Mario Bros. Wart’s Wonderland is a ROM hack of Super Mario Bros. 2 USA for NES. Created by Rohbert, it is meant to be a Holiday Season themed hack for experienced SMB2 players. It is more difficult than vanilla SMB2 but not as hard as most other SMB2 hacks. Princess and Luigi will have an easier time completing the levels, where as Toad and Mario will struggle a bit more. Graphics created by BMF54123 and Rohbert.

This hack features 10 original levels all with unique custom holiday theme sprites. There is 1 warp that is required and therefore all 10 levels must always be played. All 10 levels contain 2 power up mushrooms and a one-up. Each level features a unique color palette. All levels are complete-able with all characters. You begin with 9 lives and 5 continues.

218538.overview:
This is a romhack of Salamander, known as Life Force in western regions. The hack attempts not only to retrofit some of the enhancements afforded to the technically superior Famicom version, but also to bring the game closer overall to its original arcade release. The hack succeeds on both accounts, for better or worse.

While the graphics and palette changes are mostly visually appealing, the hack sometimes feels a little too accurate in its scope. For instance, some of the more detailed elements exclusive to the NES port are discarded in favor of restoring graphics and backgrounds to their much less detailed arcade counterparts, such as the occasional use of solid black backgrounds without any transitional borders. But this is only a minor complaint, as the vast majority of the hack is an improvement in every regard.

The author went above and beyond to provide the player with a wealth of configuration options, covering everything from regional differences to difficulty loops to preferences in soundtrack ordering. To top it all off, these preferences are saved in newly added SRAM, along with the player’s high score. Noticeably absent is any kind of leader board, but at least the high score display no longer reverts to its default value after the game is powered off.

Structural changes within the levels themselves seem to balance between the original arcade layout and the game’s home ports. One thing that bugged me was the absence of big core fights in the aircraft carrier section of the final stage, which has landing pads clearly designated for said enemies. But their lack of inclusion is by no means a deal-breaker.

The game’s base scrolling speed is increased, making levels (and the overall game) faster in pace. I find this to be perhaps the most welcome change of all, as the NES port imposed a considerably slow pacing. Consequently, the slower pace of the NES version actually made the game more difficult in some regards, as the player was forced to be exposed to environmental hazards (stage three) and enemy respawns for a greater duration of time. As mentioned earlier, the configuration menu allows the player to tweak the game’s difficulty, so selecting a higher difficulty loop will more or less offset the base decrease in difficulty resulting from the increased scroll speed.

In summary: Salamander AC Delta is the best of both worlds, and then some. Highly recommended for any veteran of the Gradius series.

218561.overview: Are you a master at Super Mario Bros.? Think you can challenge SMB2j? This game makes the first Mario look easy. More challenging levels, more obstacles, poisonous mushrooms, and crazier enemies. Built in world and stage select keep you from breaking your controllers (use A and B on the title screen). Unlike the other mapper hacked ROMs out on the internet, this is the complete game on a custom board. Mario and Luigi have different physics so they play differently. The wind works in every level it appears, so this game is tough. The game starts with all 8 stars so you can play the levels beyond 8-4. Still think you can master any NES Mario game? If so, buy this today, you won't be sorry.

218604.overview: The Ultimate Doki Doki Panic. This ROM hack is a perfect balance between Super Mario Bros 2 and Yume Koujou Doki Doki Panic. It takes bits and pieces from each other and rolls them into one for the better.

218681.overview: Street Fighter VI (12 Peoples) (1996) - This version removes Dhalsim and Zangief from the roster, possibly so the game uses less space. The title screen appears different compared to the previous versions and the game has a later copyright date, but other than that, it remains the same as the 16 Peoples version.

219740.overview: A new  adventure game for the Classic 8-bit NES where you go on a quest to find your stolen prized possesion. Keep up your courage, Sniff out clues, and use your powerful bark to chase away anything standing in your path. Remember to be a good dog and help others out along the way.

287599.overview: Abscondee is a maze game where hitting fans kills you.

308306.overview: An adorable and fun romhack that changes the music, graphics, and level structure to be a bit unlike your normal Mario game.  Play as Yoshi in this unique and colorful hack of SMB1.  While it is relatively short, it is pretty fun while it lasts.

417956.overview:
A ROM hack of Super Mario Bros. 3 by infidelity that hopes to combines a lot of the best elements of the Mario franchise, even some of the modern entries. New features Include:

Press Start at the world map to choose between Mario, Luigi, Toad or Peach.
The player can save the game on the save menu, even at world 9.
Can re-enter and exit cleared stages.
Swapping characters retains obtained power ups.
Luigi can jump higher, Toad in big form can kick enemies/blocks, Peach has SMB2 floating mechanic.
Ground pound is possible by pressing down in mid air (it can also be disabled on the pause menu), it used on a slope you gain speed.
Wall jump.
Can toss objects vertically or drop them.
Can jump off vines.
Hammer suit new ability: duck and press B to charge, release B while holding down to dash forward doing damage.
Secret feature after completing the game!

419529.overview:
Play as Nancilla. She is your ordinary, typical, everyday average girl.... raiding a Paladin Fortress to recover pages of the Necronomicon. Which she will use to bring back her parents, pets, and annoying little brother from the dead. 

NecroNancy is an undead summoning puzzle platformer. You cannot attack the heavily armored knights yourself. So you will need to learn how to summon minions like Mr Bones, Skello Kitty, Chompers, and other unspeakable skeletal abominations to clear the path forward.

419746.overview:
This is a beat-em'-up and platformer developed by Joy Van. It was released in the last quarter of 1989 by Sachen.

There's a total of five levels, each divided into four sections. Section one and three feature typical beat-em'-up gameplay. The second section is a platforming part that happens in a different cave for each level with hazards. Numerous pots with items inside are scattered throughout the cave. The last section of each level is a one on one boss fight. Items can be selected when the game is paused. To use them, press and hold the A button. As for attacks, the 1989 version of the game features punching and jumping, separately. The 1990 (international) version adds a flying kick.

NOTE: Challenge of the Dragon / Chinese KungFu (Sachen) is not to be confused with Challenge of the Dragon (Color Dreams).

420304.overview: A hastily done minihack of Super Mario Bros. (with levels designed within 2 months) that features Celeste-styled gameplay.

420559.overview:
First released on IRC and message boards in 1997, this graphical facelift project is celebrating 25 years! Super Mario Bros DX has evolved a lot since its early days of shading some background elements and porting sprites from Super Mario Bros 3, so come see what’s new! Check back occasionally, because there will be LOTS of fun extras added between now and 2024 (which will mark 25 years from the project’s landmark v1.0 release on Zophar’s Domain).

The aim of the project is to modernize the look of classic Super Mario Bros while remaining within the limits of the original programming and ROM size. There are no ASM hacks and no expanding the ROM–and no mapper! Just brand new pixel art (and a few things borrowed from later Mario games), palette edits, and metatile rearrangement. You can enjoy the original game with a fresh coat of paint, or try combining it with map or gameplay hacks that don’t change the graphics too much!

v4.4 UPDATE! This update includes new graphics and introduces a trio of brand new addendum patches to change the style. One of these includes music changes provided by Amilgi!

421034.overview: A short night-themed hack consisting of 3 worlds with 12 levels in total. Mario has to retrieve the Star Rod to save the Mushroom Kingdom.

421035.overview: A sequel to Starlight Mario consisting of 12 brand-new levels (3 worlds), along with new custom music and animations. Mario has found himself in a dark realm and must retrieve the skeleton key before it’s too late.

424016.overview: The 2013 NES Angry Birds is a surprisingly good bootleg port of the homebrew Genesis demake of the mobile phone game, decidedly blowing the low-quality 2012 Nice Code port out of the water. Rare for an NES game, nearly all of the audio (the sole exception being the sound for selecting menu items) is stored as DPCM samples, all taken from the original game.

424023.overview: This hack is a request, enjoy it!: Make a graphic improvement to a obscure fighting game developed by Hummer Team, whose only connection to Street Fighter is the title.

424038.overview: In this hack, the roles of Thomas and Sylvia have been reversed! Sylvia must now save her boyfriend, Thomas, from the evil Mr. X.

424156.overview:
The city of Nekocity is no longer peaceful... Monsters from another dimension have been released and threaten to destroy the world. Only one cat can save it: YOU!

Grab your skateboard and embark on this colorful journey of a thousand dangers.

424254.overview:
New to the Nintendo Entertainment System, It’s Space Raft: The Video Game.

Wait, what?

Yes, Milwaukee’s hungriest band Space Raft is now on the NES.

Join the band on their quest to retrieve the master tapes to their new record “Positively Space Raft” from the clutches of their jealous EX-bass player Srini!

Get behind the wheel of the Space Raft Van and steer the band past obstacles while beating the traffic. Take control of your favorite band member and clear the screen of sandwiches to thwart the plans of the meddling Srinimania!

An NES adventure designed specifically for music lovers! Recover the stolen master tapes! Release the new Space Raft record! Road trip!

– Soundtrack featuring chiptuned songs from ‘Positively Space Raft’!
– Recognizable people and places from the Milwaukee independent music scene including DMR alumni!
– Six obstacle based scrolling stages!
– Fifteen arcade style music venue stages!
– Two huge dungeon levels!
– Four playable characters with unique abilities!
– Sound Test screen with playable D-pad drum kit!
– Boss fights!
– Minifridge!
– The Sandwich!

Are you hungry enough to have what it takes?

Play it LOUD, fall into the game and go road tripping with Space Raft on the NES.

424265.overview:
The Afgard dynasty, the longest running monarchy on the Anoris continent, has ruled over the span of 1000 years. Well known for its capable military force, its influence used to spread all the way through the continent and islands to the East. 

For a long time, the united continent fought off invasion and attacks from pirates, rebels and troops from other kingdoms. In time, conflict among the neighboring territories and tribes drove to war. 

Afgard to avoid any further tensions nullified all its alliances and isolated from the rest of the continent.

For four generations the people of Afgard have lived peacefully while their military power slowly diminished. Despite this time of peace, The Kingdom started experiencing economic troubles. 

And so, the marriage with a maiden, from a prominent wealthy and powerful family from Khusa, was arranged in attempt to restore some of Afgard’s former glory. Some years have passed and now this young woman, the Queen of Afgard, has been abducted from the castle.

A legendary hero of the land returns in this time of need. With firm determination he sets forth to use his combat skills in order to rescue the Queen and help in this time of despair.

424270.overview: NES pirate game released in Hong Kong as The Hummer. It features the Hummer Team mascot, a horse named Hummer. This game is pretty much a Sonic hack for the NES, with Hummer the Horse as the main character.

424281.overview:
Ay caramba! I thoight I already defeated these creeps! What are they doing back!

I can't believe these greasy slimeballs have the guts to go toe to toe with Barthlomew J. Simpson again! Then again, I can't expect such putrid slime to learn the first time. AND these jerks smell like a monster from the bottom of the swamp... like a Swamp Thing!

In the far-future dystopia of 2004, the world has fallen under the iron grip of a malevolent A.I. bent on wiping out humanity. Most notable was the lack of scrolling; the PC version would instead show each screen one at a time.

This port brings the levels, new enemies and power-ups back to the Famicom/NES engine. Also included are most of the unique background changes and other features not possible with the original SMB engine. The end result is a much more playable game that feels like a legitimate sequel.

You and a crew of sixty other Miners are sent out to the outer reaches of the solar system and stationed on an obscure desolate moon for the next six months to mine for valuable moon rock deposits. 459463.overview:
Super Mario Bros. Definitive is a modification of the Japanese Super Mario Bros. 2 (also known as Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels) that combines all levels from said game and the original Super Mario Bros. into one ROM hack, allowing all levels from both games to be played back-to-back seamlessly. Levels from the original Super Mario Bros. are played first, with levels from The Lost Levels immediately following the final Super Mario Bros. level.

In addition to including every level from both games, Super Mario Bros. Definitive makes several small tweaks to the levels and game engine, most of which come from Super Mario All-Stars or All Night Nippon Super Mario Bros. Super Mario Bros. Definitive uses the MMC3 mapper and is based on the codebase from recent NES conversions of Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels. Below is a list of the most significant changes implemented within this ROM hack:

* A brand-new World 9 has been added for the Super Mario Bros. half, accessible after clearing all 32 Super Mario Bros. levels. The World 9 stages are based on glitch levels present in Super Mario Bros., with the 9-4 maze sharing the same loop pattern as VS. Super Mario Bros.
* Worlds A through D from The Lost Levels have been increased in difficulty by implementing modifications from Super Mario All-Stars. Specifically, Hammer Brothers now always charge the player, enemies gain a speed boost, all Goombas become Buzzy Beetles, all springs in World B are now red instead of green, and all Fake Bowsers now throw hammers. Unlike Super Mario All-Stars, Bowser in World 9 and World D now shoots fire as well.
* A couple bugfixes from All Night Nippon Super Mario Bros. have been implemented, resolving an issue that occurred when finishing a castle level with no time remaining and an issue with riding moving platforms to the bottom of the screen.
* Graphical changes have been made to certain levels. 5-1 from Super Mario Bros. and 1-1 from The Lost Levels now start with a big castle for the sake of visual consistency, 3-3 from Super Mario Bros. is now a night-time snow level, all bridge levels now contain pools of water to indicate the presence of flying Cheep-Cheeps, and the water section in 8-4 from Super Mario Bros. now uses the castle palette without the water backdrop.
* As is the case with the European release of Super Mario Bros., the one-block gaps present at the end of all water areas from that game are absent to prevent the player from easily getting stuck until time runs out.
* As in Super Mario All-Stars, the player begins with five lives and receives five lives upon continuing from a Game Over. Additionally, the maximum number of lives has been capped to 128 to prevent an issue with overflowing the life count. The lives display has been modified to properly display the life count.

467247.overview:
Super Mario Bros. Bowser’s Jumping Challenge is my SMB1 hack for the NES. I will be using SMB Utility, a great easy to use editor. I have also edited some graphics, nothing major. I updated the numbers’ font, mushrooms and the floor and solid block graphics to SMB3 style. I also added some big “B”s in different places to signify Bowser’s involvement in this challenge, it is called…Bowser’s Jumping Challenge after all.

This hack is hard, but real world hard…not save-state hard. Save-state hard means this game could only be beaten by save-stating in an emulator after every hole or bad guy. I think games design with that in mind aren’t true to the nature of console games, or any type of GAME. Games should be fun, if they can be challenging and fun, even better. But taking the player out the flow of a level so they can press F-whatever to save because they know the game will cheat them soon, is bad design, poor taste (if done intentionally) and just no fun for the player. So that’s why I call my hack real world hard. As in, if this where an actual cartridge inserted into an existing Nintendo Entertainment System, the player could actually beat the game without any artificial help.

Having said all that, SMB1BJC isn’t terribly long either. Four levels per world, 3 worlds amounts to 12 levels total to complete. Short and sweet, the perfect length in my opinion. A good old-school platformer lover gamer should eat this hack up in an afternoon. I’m gonna have to assume anyone with knowledge of this site and its type knows that a game-pad is pretty much required to play these demanding of hacks. If you can beat it using a keyboard…wow.

Princess Peach and Princess Daisy were taking a quiet vacation away from everything in Snowbite Kingdom. The peace was shattered when Bowser stole all the presents for the holiday from a nearby town! Now Princess Peach and Princess Daisy must make their way across the Kingdom of Snowbite in order to defeat Bowser and return the presents to the village.

With Mario and Luigi all the way back in the Mushroom Kingdom, can our heroines save the day?

469942.overview:
Star Keeper is a rare NES homebrew game developed by zxdplay. About 100 copies were created and sold through the Nintendo Age forum. The game was well recieved, and its gameplay has been described as a cross between Contra and Balloon Fight.

zxdplay used his own custom-made board and mapper in order to prevent piracy, which makes the game difficult to dump and emulate. The creator has also refused to do a second run of cartirdges, despite demand, because that would be unfair to people who bought cartridges secondhand as investments.

In 2023 a Windows port was released on Steam, but this is an actual port and not an emulated rom. The creator also tried to push an NFT scheme to license the IP for new games, but this failed.

470272.overview: Here is a major ASM hack which allows you to play as Mario in the Airman world of MegaMan II! It is only one stage but it is an entertaining hack and shows what can be done with hard work done! The graphics on AirMan may be garbled but it will not effect play-through. There are two versions of this patch. One which is just the AirMan stage and the other which integrates some of the first stage of Super Mario Bros. into it which makes for more of a challenge

470276.overview:
Super Mario Bros. with Touhou Project themed graphics.

The player character is based on Touhou character, Cirno.

All the levels, graphics, music, and enemies have been changed in this hack. This is a hack which has only 2 worlds to play.

470553.overview: Here is a full game hack which updates the graphics to ones pulled from Super Mario Bros. 3 and changes all the level layouts for a new game experience.

471014.overview: This is a progressive Mini kaizo hack with the “mini” representing level length. It starts off soft with some basics and progressively get harder. 7 worlds 47 levels and quick retries.

471018.overview:
Super Calm Bros is a light kaizo hack that was inspired by Kamikaze Bros and Riff Bros. The difficulty is geared towards a wide audience and should appeal to both kaizo experts and players looking to level up their skills. The hack features Costumes, Gimmicks, P Speed and Platforming.

There are 6 mandatory worlds with two bonus exits in the final world.

471019.overview: SMB Extended is a hack originally named Afterworld 8. This game has Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels Items, Hurt Blocks, and plays up to 13 worlds. Levels from Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. Deluxe VS Mode, and The Lost Levels are included.

474140.overview: This game was produced in part of a game jam, where the objective was to produce a Super Mario Bros. 1 hack within the limited timeframe of 2 days. This hack is complete and features 1 level and changed graphics, music, and text. The theme of the hack is Syobon Action, infamous for it’s troll mechanism and difficulty.

475952.overview:
This is a rom hack of Super Mario Bros 1 which changes the tile size to 4×4. The game is totally complete

The only thing that might cause confusion is the lettering, because there are some letters couldn’t get quite right at a 4×4 resolution.

477280.overview:
A barebones-but-fulllength six-stage touhou fangame for the nes/famicom about therapy sessions on the subway and feeling small in the big city. Written in nesfab in a week or so for bullet hell jam 7.

Tsukumogami have been disappearing from the human village, seemingly pulled through a buzzing rift behind kourindou, into a place that is definitely not gensokyo. Shinmyomaru follows them through.

She comes out the other side onto a grimy platform. Loud iron caterpillars screaming by, exhausted humans rushing by that can't see -- the times square mezzanine. by gripping her miracle mallet, with it's tsukumogami-adjacent powers, she can tell where the buzzing is coming from and follows it through the boroughs and below grand central station, determined to find its source.

477424.overview:
This version of Scramble was one of six games that appeared on the Konami Collector's Series: Arcade Advanced plug n' play released in 2004, and was licensed by Konami. The plug n' play was a NES-on-a-chip famiclone, and all six games were NES games. Three of the games, Gyruss, Rush 'N Attack, and Yie Are Kung Fu, had previously been released on the NES in the 80s. The other three games, Frogger, Scramble, and Time Pilot had never been released on the NES, so new ports were created by JungleTac.

Scramble is a 1981 horizontally scrolling shooter video game developed and published by Konami for arcades. It was the first side-scrolling shooter with forced scrolling and multiple distinct levels, and it established the foundation for a new genre.

477723.overview: This adjustment was made at the request of julayla. It puts the fire breathing Bowser in Subcon as the final boss, replacing Wart.

478115.overview:
A port of the pirate original GameBoy Color RPG Digimon 3 by Vast Fame. The game is loosely based on the third Digimon anime series, Digomon Tamers, but features a new story unrelated to the anime. 

Nanjing also released the game, with a title screen hack, as Shu Ma Zhan Dui 2, which translates to Digimon Adventures 2, the title of the second Digimon anime series.

478143.overview:
Sword of Mana with a turn based RPG engine. 

Much like Nanjing's other RPG ports, very few assets are actually taken from the original game, with the majority of them being taken from other games. The main character's overworld sprite, for instance, is a recolor of Mars Production's Da Hua Xi You's character sprite. All of the music featured is also reused from other Nanjing RPGs: the overworld theme also appears as the menu theme in their own Barver Battle Saga port named Tai Kong Huan Xiang; the title screen theme is also used in Chao Ji Ji Qi Ren Da Zhan A, which is by the same developer.

While the original game is a top-down action RPG (in a similar vein to the Zelda series), Nanjing's port is just a turn-based JRPG. This game suffers from balancing issues and difficulty spikes, making the game nearly unplayable without cheats or excessive grinding. Many elements from the original game were cut as well; for instance, it is only possible to play Sumo's (the male protagonist) story here, with Fuji (the female deuteragonist) appearing as a secondary party member.

478236.overview: This is a backport of Benpresto's 2001 Gameboy Advance title, Super Robot Taisen A. Nanjing released the game a second time, with a title screen hack, as Jī Qì Ren Da Zhan.

478241.overview: An unofficial pirate sequel to the Koei games Bandit Kings of Ancient China and Suikoden - Tendou 108 Sei.

478319.overview:
The game was originally released by Nanjing as San Guo Zhi: Zhi Ao Shi Tian Di. The original version had a game-breaking bug that softlocked the game and made it impossible to complete. The game was rereleased as 
Ao Shi San Guo Zhi with the bug fixed.

The game is an RPG that is based off of the early chapters of the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

478358.overview:
Lu Bu Zhuan is the second game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. Like the other games in the trilogy, this is an original RPG, but its mechanics are based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emporer, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Lu Bu.

The game was preceeded by San Gou Zhi: Cao Cao Zhuan, and it was followed by Tun Shi Tian Di 6: Liu Bei Zhuan

Lu Bu Zhuan was rereleased by Nanjing as San Guo Wu Shuang: Meng Jiang Zhuan, or Dynasty Warriors: Extreme Legends.

478359.overview:
Liu Bei Zhuan is the third and final game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. It was proceeded by San Gou Zhi: Cao Cao Zhuan and San Guo Zhi: Lu Bu Zhuan. Unlike the previous games, this game is titled Tun Shi Tian Di 6, or Destiny of the Emperor 6, making it an official sequel to the Capcom RPGs.

like the other games in the trilogy, Liu Bei Zhuan is an original RPG that uses mechanics based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emperor, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Liu Bei.

The game is sometimes listed as San Guo Zhi: Liu Bei Zhuan, keeping with the naming conventions of the earlier games in the trilogy.

478362.overview:
Cao Cao Zhuan is the first game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. The game is an original RPG, but its mechanics are based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emporer, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Cao Cao.

The game was followed by two sequels that used improved versions of its engine, San Guo Zhi: Lu Bu Zhuan, and Tun Shi Tian Di 6: Liu Bei Zhuan.

478370.overview:
This patch is designed to overhaul Silver Surfer on NES.

Features:

* All shots have increased damage 
* Hit boxes on the player have been severely reduced in both overhead and side scrolling levels. 
* Infinite Continues!

478467.overview:
This is an authorized backport of Vast Fortune's unlicensed Game Boy Color RPG of the same name. This title shouldn't be confused with the Nanjing published game with the same name, which is a separate, unofficial port of the same game.

Shui Hu Shen Shou combines the storyline of the classic Chinese novel Water Margin with Pokemon, and the Game Boy Color release was one of Vast Fortune's most popular titles. Unfortunately this title is a very loose port of the original game, and although the Waixing port is considered better than the unofficial Nanjing port, it's still considered inferior to the original release.

478468.overview:
This is an unofficial backport of Vast Fortune's unlicensed Game Boy Color RPG of the same name. This title should be confused with the official, authorized port published by Waixing.

Shui Hu Shen Shou combines the storyline of the classic Chinese novel Water Margin with Pokemon, and the Game Boy Color release was one of Vast Fortune's most popular titles. The Nanjing port is considered inferior to the original game, and is also considered worse than the official Waixing port.

The game was later rereleased by Nanjing as Liang Shan Ying Xiong,

478561.overview: A strategy game based on the Heroes of the Sui and Tang Dynasties story cycle. The game is very similar to, and uses the same engine as Nanjing's Shui Hu 3.

478565.overview:
This is a backport of SNK's Shinsetsu Samurai Spirits – Bushido Retsuden, also known as the Samurai Shodown RPG, that was released on the Neo Geo CD, Playstation, and Saturn. 

Shinsetsu Samurai Spirits – Bushido Retsuden is an RPG based on SNK's Samurai Shodown fighting game franchise.

478703.overview: A backport of the 2002 PC game of the same name by Heluo Studio.

478933.overview: RPG based off the Wuxia novel The Legend of the Condor Heroes.

479308.overview: Dan Qi Shi Dai is an unofficial backport of the Korean MMORPG Stone Age. Unlike the original MMORPG it is based on, this is just a standard NES RPG that's similar to Nanjing's other RPGs. Nanjing later rereleased the game as Xian Jie Jing Ling.

479309.overview: The game's title means Sudoku, but it's actually a 2-in-1 compilation. The compilation is made up of an original Sudoku game by Nanjing, and a bootleg of Gomoku Narabe Renju, which was original published by Nintendo for the NES in 1983.

479469.overview: RPG based on the Chinese television show My Own Swordsman.

479636.overview: An RPG based on the 2005 Chinese animated film Sparkling Red Star! The 2005 film is based on an earlier live-action Chinese propaganda film released in 1974, which was one of the very few films released during the Cultural Revolution.

479777.overview: San Guo Da Luan Dou: Zhan Guo is an RPG based on the first game in Koei's Warriors Orochi series. Warriors Orochi is a hack 'n slash crossover that has historical characters from China's Three Kingdoms period meeting historical characters from Japan's Warring States period. San Guo Da Luan Dou: Zhan Guo isn't a true backport, because it's an entirely different genre, and it instead just uses characers from Warriors Orochi and elements of its story. However Nanjing still marketed the game as if it were a backport of Warriors Orochi.

480058.overview: RPG based on the Chinese novel The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.

480412.overview: SUPER MARIO BROS. rom hack (NES) that modernises the way the game plays : the feel, the response, the experience with a pad in hand. The visuals and the sound have been reworked too.

480707.overview: A board game that takes a lot of inspiration from Monopoly.

480710.overview: A backport of the DOS game Xiake Yingxiongzhuan.

480712.overview:
An unauthorized port of Vast Fame's Game Boy Color game Digital Monsters 3 for the Famicom.

Like the Game Boy Color game, Shuma Baolong 4 is an RPG based on the Digimon Adventure anime. The player can select from one of the eight Digidestined (which determines the player's sprite and starter Digimon). However, not every starter mon is paired with their corresponding kid. The game plays mostly the same but much cruder, as player portraits are sized-up tracings of the original portrait graphics and damage calculation is buggy and somewhat random. On top of this, the wild Digimon that show up in each area is not accurate, as Betamon is one of the enemies you encounter in the first dungeon when normally you only encounter baby Digimon.

Most of the music consists of unique compositions, with none of the soundtracks from the original Game Boy Color game being present. At least one of the tracks is reused from Waixing's Bio Hazard Famicom game, which was also developed by Mars Production

480715.overview: An unofficial backport of the cinematic platformer Blackthorne.

480941.overview: Backport of the PC game Richman 2, a board game similar to Monopoly.

481829.overview: The original Super Mario Bros. game but it is 2 player Co-Op!

482647.overview: Collectorvision planned for Sydney Hunter and the Mayan's Revenge to be their first NES release, and a prototype was released in 2014 to promote the game. However the game was plagued with delays, and partway through development Collectorvision decided to reprogram the game in Unity and release it on modern systems instead. The game was finally released on modern systems in 2019 with its name changed to Sydney Hunter and the Curse of the Mayan. The NES version was never completed.
